newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 18-THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 27.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 18-THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 27.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 18

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIFTH CHAMBER(0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-294/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 93/42/EEC of June 14, 1993, on medical devices.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-400/95 Dansk Handel and Service: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Dismissal due to absences owing to sickness caused by pregnancy or birth of a child.
THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 20

COURT OF JUSTICE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-144/94 IDE v/ Commission: company law. Action based on arbitration clause. Contract for the production of a software programme "Disnet". Payment of sums outstanding. - Judgment C-128/95 Fontaine: competition. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Commission regulation 123/85 of December 12, 1984, on the application of EC treaty article 85, paragraph 3 to automobile distribution, sales and after sales contracts. Notion of new and used vehicles. Faculty for a parallel importer to exercise at once the functions of dealer and reseller of imported vehicles. - Opinion C-93/96 ICT: trade policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 3, of Council regulation 738/92 of March 23, 1992, laying down a definitive dumping duty on cotton fibre imports from Brazil and Turkey. Increase of net "franco frontier" charge after a period of more than 30 days. Contract providing two prices in function of chosen payment period.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-336/95 Burdalo Trevejo: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 1, paragraph 3 and 3, paragraph 3 of Council directive 77/187/EEC of February 14, 1977, on the maintenance of workers' rights in the event of transfers of undertakings, businesses or parts of businesses. Legal or jurisprudential reduction of guaranteed amount under Council directive 80/987/EEC of October 20, 1980, on the approximation of member state legislation on protection of salaried workers in cases of employer bankruptcy. Admissibility.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-88/95, C-102/95, C-103/95 Martinez Losada: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 48, paragraph 2, and 51, and of article 67, paragraph 1 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. National legislation on unemployment benefit intended for unemployed people over a certain age, for persons with pension rights in the national old age pension scheme. - Judgment C-107/95-P Bundesverband der Bilanzbuchhalter v/ Commission: company law. Appeal against Court order (fourth chamber) rendered January 23, 1995, in case T-84/94 Bundesverband der Bilanzbuchhalter v/ Commission. Admissibility of an action for annulment against the decision not to open a procedure under EC treaty article 169 and the decision not to open a procedure under EC treaty article 90, paragraph 3. - Judgment C-166/95-P Commission v/ Daffix: statute of officials. Appeal against Court judgment (third chamber), rendered March 28, 1995, in cases T-12/94, Daffix v/ Commission. Annulment of a disciplinary measure. Customary examination of whether there are sufficient grounds. Reason for a disciplinary measure. - Opinion C-260/95 DFDS: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 26 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Special arrangements for travel agencies. Agency headquartered in member state A furnishing package tours to travellers through the intermediary of a company based in member state B. Circumstances in which these services are subject to VAT in member state B. Notion of a member state in which the travel agency has set up the headquarters of its economic activity and of a stable base from which services have been provided. - Opinion C-223/95 Moksel: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 9, paragraph 2 of the EC treaty, and article 8, paragraph 1 of Commission regulation 3665/87 of November 27, 1987, laying down detailed rules for the application of export refunds on agricultural products. Export refunds. Bovines from former East Germany, located in West Germany before the economic and monetary union of the two Germanys and their reunification, with a view to slaughter and export to the Soviet Union. Export after the unification. - Oral procedure C-329/95 VAG Sverige: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 70/156/EEC of February 6, 1970, on the approximation of legislation on the type approval of automotive vehicles and their trailers. National regulation subjecting the registration of a car for use in Sweden to the obligatory furnishing of a certificate for motor vehicle pollution levels.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-106/95 MSG: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 5, point 1 and article 17, first line of the Brussels Convention. Contractual clause designating the chain of execution of an obligation. Stipulation aimed solely at establishing judicial competence. Prorogation of competence. Convention attributing jurisdiction. Form accepted in international trade. Silence following a commercial letter of confirmation. - Judgment C-344/95 Commission v/ Belgium: free movement of persons. Non respect. EC treaty article 48, and Council directive 68/360 of October 15, 1968, on the suppression of restrictions on travel and residence by member state workers and their families inside the EU. Belgian regulations on residence permits for EU citizens. Order to leave the territory given to job seekers after three months. Arrangements for immatriculation certificates and for certificates granted to workers resident for under three months. - Judgment C-135/96 Commission v/ Belgium: approximation of legislation. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Commission directive 91/659/EEC of December 3, 1991, adapting the technical progress of annex I of Council directive 76/769/EEC on the coordination of member states' laws, regulations and administrative provisions on the limited marketing and use of certain dangerous substances and preparations (asbestos). - Opinion C-219/95-P Ferriere Nord v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against court judgment (first chamber) rendered April 6, 1995, in case T-143/89, Ferriere Nord v/ Commission. Refusal to annul Commission decision 89/515 of August 2, 1989, on an application procedure for EC treaty article 85. - Opinion C-243/95 Hill: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 75/117/EEC of February 10, 1975, on the approximation of the laws of member states on the application of the principle of equal pay for men and women. Part time workers in a job-sharing scheme. Conversion to full time. Salary rises calculated on the basis of hours worked part time. - Opinion C-269/95 Benincasa: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 13, paragraph 1, 14, paragraph 1 and 17, and 17, paragraph 1 of the Brussels Convention. Competence in matters of consumer contracts. Notion of consumer. Franchise contract concluded with a view to future professional activity. Prorogation of competence. Convention attributing jurisdiction. Action for acknowledgement that the contract containing the clause extending competence is null and void. - Opinion C-8/96 Locamion: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 69/335/EEC of July 17, 1969, on indirect taxes on the raising of capital. National law maintaining a registration duty on merger/take-over operations. Vehicle rental coorporation. Immatriculation tax on vehicles. - Oral procedure C-279/94 Commission v/ Italy: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Article 8, paragraph 1 and 9 of Council directive 83/189/EEC of March 28, 1983, on a procedure for the provision of information in the field of technical standards and regulations. Adaptation of law 257 of March 27, 1992, on stopping the uses of asbestos. Absence of prior notification to the Commission. - Oral procedure C-131/96 Mora Romera: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 6, 48 and 51 and of article 7 of Council regulation 1612/68 of October 15, 1968, on freedom of movement for workers within the Community. National law on social security benefit allowing a prolongation of benefit for orphans, to account for a period of interruption in training for compulsory military service. Compulsory service carried out in the forces of another member state in which the orphan has citizenship.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 25-27
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 25
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-189/95 Franzen: free movement of goods.
SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-150/95 Portugal v/ Commission: agriculture. - (1030/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-145/96 van Hoffmann: taxation.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged) (0915/0815 GMT) - Judgment joined cases T-149/94, T-181/94 Kernkraftwerke Lippe-Ems v/ Commission: contracts.
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 26

FIRST CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-239/94 EISA v/ Commission: steel. - Oral procedure T-243/94 British Steel v/ Commission: state aid. - Oral procedure T-244/94 Wirtschaftsvereinigung v/ Commission: state aid.
THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 27

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-59/95 Bastos Moriana: free movement of persons. - Judgment C-177/95 Ebony Maritime: external relations. - Opinion C-316/95 Generics: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-349/95 Loendersloot: free movement of goods.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-220/95 Van den Boogaard: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. - Opinion joined cases C-248/95, C-249/95 SAM Schiffahrt: transport. - Opinion joined cases C-370/95, C-371/95, C-372/95 Careda: taxation. - Opinion C-63/96 Skripalle: taxation. - Oral Procedure C-127/95 Norbrook Laboratoires: approximation of legislation. - Oral procedure C-29/96 Norbrook Laboratories: approximation of legislation.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-167/95 Linthorst, Pouwels en Scheres: taxation. - Judgment C-23/96 Commission v/ France: approximation of legislation. - Opinion C-90/94 Haahr Petroleum: free movement of goods. - Opinion joined cases C-114/95, C-115/95 Texaco: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-242/95 GT-Link: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-299/95 F. Kremzow: institutional law. - Opinion C-330/95 Goldsmiths: taxation. - Opinion C-41/96 SYD-COnsult: competition. - Opinion C-114/96 Kieffer: free movement of goods. - Oral procedure C-259/95 Parliament v/ Council: environment and consumers. - (1115/1215 GMT) Oral procedure C-60/96 Commission v/ France: taxation.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment T-106/95 FFSA v/ Commission: state aid. END OF DOCUMENT.
